VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: ATT

The CI log (ATT) confirms criterion (2)—all 64 tests pass. However, it provides no evidence for criterion (1): that the stale-quote eviction bug is actually fixed. A passing test suite only demonstrates the bug is fixed if there is a test that specifically reproduces the stale-quote eviction condition and verifies the corrected behavior. Nothing in the evidence establishes that such a test exists; the prior suite may have passed without ever covering this bug. Without proof that the fix is exercised by a failing-then-passing test (or other direct verification of the eviction behavior), criterion (1) is unsubstantiated.
